alert: decypharr repair job has STOPPED RUNNING
description: No '[repair] Starting repair' line for 8 hours, though it's configured to run every 6h. A job that never starts logs no errors, so the failing-alert above cannot catch this — hence alertOnAbsent (absentFor is in MINUTES).

filter.expression: service.name = 'decypharr' AND component = 'repair' AND body CONTAINS 'Starting repair'

annotations.summary: decypharr repair has not run in 8h
annotations.description: Check repair.enabled is still true in decypharr's config.json.
